_comment: Single source of truth for every EWSAtlas build parameter. Scripts in src/ read ONLY from here.

qc._gene_floor_rationale: Assay-aware, not uniform: nuclei carry ~10-20% of a cell's RNA and are depleted of cytoplasmic/mito transcripts, so one integer imposes different effective stringency per assay and preferentially discards the smallest nuclei - biasing survivors toward large, transcriptionally active, cycling malignant cells.
qc._library_gate_rationale: Exclude a whole library whose MEDIAN detected genes falls below its assay floor. A per-cell floor and a per-sample MAD cannot catch a uniformly failed library - the MAD is computed within that library, so a bad library looks internally consistent. Measured case: ScPCA library SCPCL001111 has median 44 genes / 76 UMIs and 98.5% of nuclei under 200 genes; ScPCA's own pipeline retained 89 of 6,139 cells (1.4%). Every other library has median >=237.
qc._mito_cap_rationale: Same logic as the gene floor: the CRITERION is the per-sample MAD on %MT (uniform everywhere); the absolute cap is a per-assay backstop reflecting each assay's biology. Measured here: the four droplet whole-cell studies sit at median 2.8-3.9% MT with p95 9-14%, so 30% is effectively non-binding for them (a 20% cap would cost 0-70 cells). Nuclei are DEPLETED of mitochondrial transcripts (median 1.99%, p95 10.2% across the 85,944 nuclei that pass the library gate), so a 30% cap is lenient exactly where it should be strict - a nucleus above 10% MT carries cytoplasmic/ambient carryover, which inflates apparent stromal signal in malignant nuclei and is the same confounder as a doublet. The 10% cap costs 4,441 of 85,944 nuclei (5.2%) against 366 (0.4%) at 30%. CEL-seq2 plates run hotter once ERCC spike-ins are removed (per-plate medians 13-27%), so a 30% cap would cut around the median of several plates - composition bias by the same argument; 40% is the backstop there.
qc._doublet_rate_rationale: 10x multiplet rate is ~0.8% per 1,000 cells recovered, so the expected doublet fraction scales with library size (7,000 nuclei -> ~5.6%; 14,000 -> ~11%). A single score threshold ignores that. Measured on the Waltner arm, a fixed 0.25 cut removed 2.9% of nuclei while ScPCA's independent scDblFinder flagged 9.9% of the SAME retained nuclei (score Spearman rho 0.41). Doublets are load-bearing for this atlas: a malignant+stromal doublet mimics the fusion-low mesenchymal state under study, so under-calling would manufacture the finding.
qc._doublet_note: Explicit threshold because scikit-image (needed for scrublet's automatic threshold) is refused by host policy in this install.
qc._assay_key_note: Keys here are the SAME tokens as obs['assay'] and metadata assay (10x_scRNA, 10x_snRNA, CELseq2_scRNA). They previously read 'CEL-seq2' while the covariate table said 'CELseq2_scRNA' - two spellings of one fact, the defect the controlled vocabulary exists to prevent. tests/test_invariants.py now asserts every by-assay block keys exactly on the controlled vocabulary.

gene_space.rule: intersection of per-study annotations, restricted to genes detected in >=3 cells in >=1 study
gene_space._rule_note: min_cells_detected and detected_in_n_studies are the machine-readable form of 'rule'; src/ reads these two, never the prose. Requiring detection in EVERY study penalises the shallowest arm; the union admits structural zeros that an integration model reads as biology.
gene_space._prefix_note: Aynaud GSE130024 ships 4 samples with GRCh38_-prefixed symbols and 1 with plain symbols; without stripping, the intersection silently matches only the plain sample and zeroes 13,064 cells.

hvg._hvg_note: study-level, not sample-level: per-sample seurat_v3 fails with a loess singularity on the small CEL-seq2 plates.

integration._scvi_note: encode_covariates/layer_norm/batch_norm follow NBAtlas (doi 10.1016/j.celrep.2024.114804) and the scArches-recommended configuration; the previous 120-epoch run never triggered early stopping, i.e. was under-trained.
integration._batch_key_note: Run both: 56 sample-level batches on ~100k cells spends many batch-specific parameters and is a suspected contributor to the 78.1% same-study neighbour structure measured on v4.0.

annotation._cnv_note: NBAtlas used CopyKAT + SCEVAN (R); infercnvpy is the Python equivalent and avoids the Bioconductor load failures seen in this sandbox.

controlled_vocabulary._note: Allowed values per covariate. A harmonized atlas whose own columns carry two spellings of the same fact (sex 'M' and 'male'; sort 'cd45+' and 'live_CD45pos_FACS') has not harmonized anything; tests/test_invariants.py enforces this list.
